description: Designation of bodies/laboratories by Member States is presupposed by the tense 'which they have designated' but not stated as an operative duty, power or criteria within the frozen statements. Wider Art 10(1) and 10(4) text was seen incidentally while resolving the Art 9 cross-reference and was not used.
treatment: R-P03-05 recorded as DEFERRED; no Member State-to-notified-body relation accepted.

description: 'Procedures referred to in Article 9' resolved by Art 9(1)-(2): EC type-examination (Annex I) or declaration of conformity (Annex IV), type-examination accompanied by declaration under Annex II or III. The notification scope is therefore all Art 9 procedures, not specific to Annex III.
treatment: Cross-reference recorded in R-P03-01; no coupling to Annex III statements inferred from it.

description: Whether 'notified body' in the Annex III statements is the category of 'bodies' notified under Art 10(1). Wider Annex III point 6 refers to 'each notified body referred to in Article 10(1)'.
treatment: Identity accepted as resolved by wider text but not used to couple statements into one configuration (see U-04).

description: A cross-level chain Member States -> Commission (notification) and notified body -> manufacturer (assessment) would need a qualified coupling. The only candidate coupling (designation) is deferred; shared naming of 'notified body' is insufficient.
treatment: Chain declined as a configuration (X-P03-2); tested in S-04.

description: Counterparty (owner of the quality system) is not expressed in the statement; wider Annex III points 2 and 3.1 indicate the manufacturer.
treatment: Statement kept as ASSIGNMENT_ONLY; R-P03-02 rests on CS-P03-005; wider text not counted as support.

description: Passive construction: the notifier (and decider) is not expressed. 'The decision' has an antecedent in the preceding sentence of point 3.3 (assessment), outside the statement.
treatment: Actor not supplied; relation DEFERRED; reading tested in S-03.

description: The register anchors these statements to Annex III. Identical wording of CS-P03-004, -005 and -006 appears verbatim in Annex IV (3.3, 4.3); CS-P03-003 differs from Annex IV only by a spelling variant ('asses').
treatment: Claims confined to the Annex III anchor; no generalisation to Annex IV or to Art 9 procedures as a whole.

description: 'At reasonable intervals' is an open-textured standard: a textual indicator of choice over timing; range, constraint and reviewability are not stated.
treatment: Recorded as an indicator only; no discretion level coded.

description: One sentence yields an audit statement and an audit-report statement (coordinate 'and shall provide'). At relation level the split is by type (verification vs information).
treatment: Split retained; merge tested in S-02.

description: The frozen excerpt is the first sentence of Art 10(2). The next sentence (seen incidentally) concerns notified bodies applying criteria for the designation of laboratories: a potential notified body-laboratory link outside the frozen statements.
treatment: Not evaluated, not coded; flagged for a scope decision.

description: The public/private or organisational status of 'notified body' is not stated in the statements.
treatment: No public-private allocation or intermediary-role claim made.

description: The grammatical subject is 'independent audit' (an activity), not an actor. Identification with 'the auditor' of CS-P04-002 (same paragraph) is a provisional reading.
treatment: R-P04-01 accepted provisionally with human review; effect tested in S-05.

description: The object of the audit (the Registry's administration of the phased registration) is not in the frozen excerpts; it comes from the third sentence of Art 12(5), consulted to resolve 'audit of what'.
treatment: R-P04-05 accepted at cross_provision_inference with human review.

description: 'At the expense of the Registry' states cost-bearing without a payee.
treatment: R-P04-04 REJECTED; retained as a condition of the statement.

description: The effect of 'after consulting the Commission' (binding or not; consequence if omitted) is not stated; it is not 'consent' (compare CS-P04-010).
treatment: No authority attributed to the Commission over the appointment; thin participation relation only.

description: The audit is called 'independent' while the auditor is appointed, and the audit paid for, by the entity whose administration is audited (per wider text). The statements specify no safeguard defining independence.
treatment: No inference about actual independence or conflict of interest; features recorded only.

description: The means by which the Registry 'requires' conduct (contract, rule) and any consequence of non-compliance are not stated.
treatment: Coded as command (requirement) with means unspecified; no sanction or supervision attributed.

description: 'A validation agent indicated by the Registry': the recipient of the indication and the process of allocation among agents are not stated.
treatment: R-P04-09 DEFERRED; no designation relation inferred.

description: 'The deadline' and 'first in line' are undefined in the statements; wider Art 14 text gives a forty-day receipt deadline and examination in order of receipt.
treatment: Used for wording only; no new statement or relation added.

description: The legal effect of the agent's finding or notification on any registration outcome is not stated within the 20 statements; the registration decision is outside the frozen scope.
treatment: Gateway, delegation of decision authority and consequence not established; R-P04-22 DEFERRED.

description: Two notification statements (adverse/late; positive) are joined into one relation (same parties, same type, different conditions).
treatment: Joined at relation level, kept separate at statement level; split tested in S-02.

description: 'or' joins late receipt (no finding) and an adverse finding under one notification duty ('of this').
treatment: Both retained as textual alternatives in the condition field.

description: The Commission's rights as beneficiary are not stated in the statement; wider Art 15(2) states terms (seen, not used).
treatment: R-P04-13 accepted as a thin designation only, with human review.

description: 'Shall give its consent' is mandatory in form but does not say whether the Commission may refuse, nor the consequence of absent consent. The counterpart is derived by anaphora ('that agreement').
treatment: R-P04-14 accepted at cross_provision_inference; discretion and validity effects not coded; readings tested in S-07.

description: Temporal order agreement -> deposit is entailed by 'the escrow agent' but not stated; the purpose of the escrow is not in the 20 statements.
treatment: Order marked as entailed, not textual; function coded uncertain.

description: Passive: the submitter(s) of complaints and of responses are not expressed; 'complainant' appears only as chooser of the provider.
treatment: R-P04-17 DEFERRED; reading tested in S-03.

description: 'The list referred to in the first paragraph of Article 23' resolved by Art 23(1): a list of ADR providers published on the Registry's website, read as the providers the Registry selects.
treatment: Cross-reference resolved by wider text; identification list = Registry-selected providers recorded as cross_provision_inference.

description: The frozen excerpt is the first sentence of Art 22(6); the remainder (seen incidentally) is outside the frozen statements and not evaluated. 'Properly filed' and 'appropriate fee' are undefined in the statement.
treatment: Not evaluated; relation coded as information only; flagged for a scope decision.

description: 'In an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner' attaches most naturally to 'select' but is syntactically adjacent to 'reputable bodies with appropriate expertise'.
treatment: Natural reading adopted (manner of selection); alternative tested in S-08.

description: 'May select' is a permission, while CS-P04-012 presupposes a list: dependency of the complainant's choice on the exercise of a permissive power.
treatment: Recorded as a positional observation; no obligation to select inferred.

description: The Registry appears in many statements; its frequency is a product of the frozen selection of statements.
treatment: No centrality or hub claim; tested in S-10.

description: The public/private status of the auditor, validation agents, escrow agent and ADR providers is not stated in the statements.
treatment: No public-private allocation or intermediation claim made.

description: The audit concerns the phased registration, of which the validation procedure is a part, but no statement says the audit covers validation agents.
treatment: Link by temporal/contextual membership only; R-P04-25 REJECTED; tested in S-09.

description: One relation supported by two statements (bodies vs laboratories; 'notify' vs 'inform').
treatment: Joined at relation level; split tested in S-01.
